prv_nonlinear.notes: Secondary optical pulse-rate-variability research statistics on equal-length gap-free segments; not ECG HRV and not a measure of autonomic disease, fitness or exercise thresholds.

respiratory_variability.notes: RSA-derived estimates; weak RSA, ectopics, medication or missing R-R can erase estimated breaths without airflow stopping; an unobserved breath is not an apnea; not measured ventilation/tidal volume/respiratory effort.

stage_physiology.notes: Stage-conditioned physiology is model-dependent (sleep-v2 stages are estimates); stage-conditioned HRV does not independently prove autonomic changes. No clinical claim is made.

notes: Exploratory breakpoint feature: NOT an established sleep-onset detector.
Wrist skin temperature also moves with room temperature, bedding, contact, medication or fever; no vasodilation, core temperature or causation is inferred from the wrist channel alone.
The request carries no charging/wear evidence per skin-temperature sample, so charging-interval exclusion is not applied in this wave; minute validity is time-support only.
acrophase is skin-temperature acrophase, not DLMO or core-temperature minimum

Wrist skin temperature also follows room temperature, bedding, clothing and activity; the observed rhythm describes the wrist channel only and implies no endogenous clock phase, melatonin timing or cause.
is / iv here are TEMPERATURE regularity on hourly skin-temperature bins (local clock hours for IS; consecutive valid UTC hours across midnight for IV), not rest-activity regularity.
Uncertainty is the larger of the OLS delta-method SE and a delete-one-day jackknife; hourly residuals are autocorrelated, so the OLS SE alone would be optimistic.
Drift is measured on elapsed UTC time; clock changes are relabelings and never count as physiological drift. Retrospective description only.

observed_realignment.definition: fraction = observed UTC acrophase change / UTC change needed to keep the pre-change local acrophase; descriptive, no forecast

rebound.notes: Descriptive next-night differences from your own usual night after short or fragmented nights in the history window. Not a cause, a prediction or a probability; nights are as the published snapshot measured them.

rest_activity_rhythm.gate: >= 5 days with movement supported in >= 80% of local hours (an hour needs >= 30 worn minutes with >= 30 one-second gravity adjacencies) and every 6-hour local quadrant observed
notes: Signal: seconds per minute whose 1 Hz gravity vector changed by at least the threshold from the previous second (an orientation-change proxy that only sees motion surviving the strap's 1 Hz downsample). It is not an activity count: no count threshold and no binarisation are applied.
Hours without worn movement evidence stay missing; activity-decoder labels never fill observation gaps.
